g.text: Annual education spending per student (log scale)
Half of rural Balochistan students spend Rs 3,500 a year or less; the top tenth spend Rs 18,700 or more
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person file. Sample: students in rural Balochistan with education spending above zero (n = 1,464). Weighted by hhweight.
1 students outside Rs 100 to Rs 1,000,000 are excluded from the histogram; median and percentiles use all students.
